name: mermaid-lens
description: Browser extension: pan, zoom, full-screen, highlight, animate and copy Mermaid diagrams.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.icons: rsvg-convert -w 16 -h 16 assets/icon-16.svg -o icons/icon-16.png && rsvg-convert -w 32 -h 32 assets/icon-32.svg -o icons/icon-32.png && for s in 48 128; do rsvg-convert -w $s -h $s assets/icon.svg -o icons/icon-$s.png; done
